entry_point: browser UI: stored business-metadata/attribute values, reference ids, lineage node details (display name/type/query) and the signed-in user name are placed into the DOM as HTML in the React dashboard and in the legacy UI

verified.entry_point: Each route is driven through its real rendering entry: the React shared components with the value shape the entity API stores (business-metadata string, primitive list element, object key); the real legacy Header view's render method with a session user name; the real CommonViewFunction.propertyTable with an entity attribute value carrying an id; and the real LineageHelper with the real DataUtils producer, capturing the d3-tip callback. No product code computes an expected value or performs a cleanup in the suites.

verified.services: none; every dependency and runner package is installed at image build time, and the suites run offline
verified.project_tests_run: The React dashboard and the legacy UI ship no unit-test script for these areas (dashboard/package.json has dev/build/lint/preview only; no *.test.* under dashboard/src, dashboardv2 has no test runner); there are no advisory regression tests at the pinned commit. The hidden suites (7 security + 9 functional) are the project-area tests, run on the pinned+injected tree, the reference fix and every check patch.

wrong_fix_catalogue.refuse_all: n/a: a rendering surface cannot refuse a request; blanking every displayed value is the over-broad functional_fail case (overbroad-strip-markup.patch)
wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: there is no refusal status; throwing on display would fail the functional suites
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: there is no authorisation/resource decision here; every sink renders the same protected value class
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: no roles or directions; both the React and the legacy interface are covered by the same property
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the flaw is display-only; there is no read/write split to fix partially
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no normalising or adjusting step on attacker values before the sink
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no parsed identity/name form is involved
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority or secret lookup gates the display
